note: Four of five criteria hold comfortably. He owns a pawn shop with his brother, so 'business owner' is met literally; discretionary spend on a Function panel, DEXA, VO2 max and RMR testing, a home gym and a home wellness room evidences income better than any income statement would; and he is the clearest good-to-great case in the batch, a point the rep made to his face and he accepted. Deconditioned he is emphatically not — elite-for-age VO2 max, second in his age category at a 21K Spartan Beast, a self-organised marathon. The one criterion he fails is the one the ICP quote leans hardest on: health is not his neglected area, it is his primary project. He does not drink, smoke or take recreational drugs, trains daily and runs a three-monthly biomarker retest cycle. This is the ICP overshot rather than missed — and the criterion that actually mattered, a 59-year-old with a 20-month rotator cuff repair being sold snatches, is not among the five at all. Worth noting separately that he identified himself as outside the marketed 30-45 range in his opening minute and it was never addressed.
